title: Window Adjustment Schedule for Extension Visits
content:
When an In-Group Specialist Referral, an HMO Specialist Referral, an Out-of-Network Referral or a Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is extended, the window adjustment of the extension visits follows the days from the handling date to the valid-through date: 84 days or more add one visit, fewer than 42 days take one visit away, and anything in between changes nothing.

| Calendar days from the handling date to the valid-through date | Window adjustment |
|---|---|
| 84 or more | one visit added |
| 42 to 83 | no change |
| 41 or fewer | one visit taken away |

The days are counted in calendar days from the handling date to the valid-through date shown on the referral.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical referrals).** 84 days left adds one visit and 83 days left changes nothing; 42 days left changes nothing and 41 days left takes one visit away.
